title: Resident Capability and Tool Access Integration

staged_artifacts.purpose: Resident-specific capability and tool-access resolution with approval, denied, and unavailable states.
Focused staged coverage for Alfred, Helen, Grace candidate, unknown residents, and display payloads.
Staged workstream overview and isolation boundary.

intended_install_paths.install_mode: adapt imports from staged module to active module

install_steps: Review active resident authority, resident interaction, connector/model-control, and Office resident/status surfaces for conflicts.
Copy staged resolver into src/estate/core/resident_capability_access.py or merge equivalent functions into the selected active module.
Wire resident interaction and CLI surfaces to call resolve_resident_capabilities for resident-specific capability payloads.
Wire Office resident/status surfaces to consume capability_display_payload or office_capability_payload.
Preserve safe defaults: unknown residents and undeclared tools must remain denied.
Adapt staged tests into active tests and run focused plus affected Office/resident test suites.

post_install_commands: PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/test_resident_authority.py tests/test_resident_interaction.py tests/test_office_resident_presence.py tests/test_office_resident_actions.py tests/test_resident_capability_access.py
acceptance_checks: Capability resolution is deterministic for the same resident and requested tools.
No resident silently gains undeclared access.
Unavailable tools report state=unavailable rather than approved.
Approval-required operations expose requires_approval metadata and reasons.
Unknown residents receive no implied capability or tool access.

rollback: Remove src/estate/core/resident_capability_access.py if installed as a new module.
Revert resident interaction, authority, CLI, and Office surface wiring changes from WP-4031.
Remove or revert active tests adapted from the staged WP-4022 tests.
Re-run the pre-install resident and Office test subset to confirm restoration.
dependencies: resident interaction surfaces for display handoff

conflict_risks.mitigation: Install only after WP-4031 conflict review; prefer adding a separate module and thin integration calls.
Reuse existing authority decisions; avoid changing authority semantics unless reviewed.
Expose additive display payloads before replacing existing status output.

review_requirements: WP-4031 conflict review before active installation.
Steward review of resident-specific tool declarations before production use.
Office surface review to confirm denied/unavailable/approval-required states display truthfully.
Runtime environment review for executable and connector probes.
